context: Closing meeting summarizing a multi-year personnel review
purpose: Teach: 中小/従業/掛け/ポスト/サラリーマン/適正/大半/にわたって

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: では、今回の人事評価の総まとめに入ろう。長期にわたってご苦労だったな。
lines.en: Well then, let's move into the final summary of this personnel review. Thank you for your hard work over such a long period.
lines.style: Formal boss opening a closing meeting with measured authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資料を拝見しましたが、従業員一人ひとりの能力がかなり丁寧に分析されていますね。
lines.en: Yes. I've looked through the materials, and each employee's abilities have been analyzed quite carefully.
lines.style: Polite subordinate confirming review with respectful desu-masu tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うむ。特に中小の取引先を担当してきた中堅社員の働きが、想像以上に大きかった。
lines.en: Indeed. The contribution of mid-level staff handling our small-and-medium-sized clients was greater than I had imagined.
lines.style: Reflective senior manager acknowledging unsung contributions with gravitas.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そうですね。大半の社員は普通のサラリーマンに見えますが、各々が確かな専門性を備えております。
lines.en: That's true. Most of the staff look like ordinary salarymen, but each one possesses real expertise.
lines.style: Thoughtful office worker reframing perceptions with humble formal register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 問題はポスト配分だ。これまで年功序列に重きを掛けすぎてきた面があるな。
lines.en: The issue is post allocation. We've placed too much weight on seniority-based promotion until now.
lines.style: Decisive executive raising a structural concern with deliberate phrasing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おっしゃる通りです。実力ある若手を、適正なポストに早めに就けるべきかと存じます。
lines.en: Exactly as you say. We should place capable younger staff into appropriate posts sooner.
lines.style: Agreeable but assertive recommendation in polite business register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: よし。来期からは新しい基準で全社員を見直そう。今日は良い議論ができた。
lines.en: Good. From next term we'll reassess all employees with new criteria. We had a good discussion today.
lines.style: Boss closing the meeting with firm resolve and slight relief.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、ありがとうございました。明日からまた具体案を詰めてまいります。
lines.en: Yes, thank you very much. I'll continue working out the concrete proposals from tomorrow.
lines.style: Closing words with forward-looking humble desu-masu tone.
